description: Connect your Tap buyer account to plan campaigns, manage public RFPs across media types and private TV and radio RFPs, and compare supplier responses. Discover supplier Deals and digital out-of-home inventory, prepare unsent direct-buy drafts, and track existing Orders, correspondence and creative fulfillment. External messages, RFP publication and destructive changes require approval. The plugin cannot place Orders, record bookings, make payments or serve advertisements.

defaultPrompt: Get radio pricing for a four-week Dallas campaign with an $80,000 budget.
Turn this media plan into RFPs and request real pricing from suitable TV and radio stations.
Compare the supplier proposals for my campaign and recommend the best-value buy.
